system.description:
Some Toreador have learned to leave a residual Presence in their wake. Artists of the clan can imbue their artwork with certain emotions; territorial Toreador may leave palpable claims to a domain wherein it feels as if they are a constant, looming threat. The character can inspire an emotion in those who view a work of art or enter a marked area, even when she is not present, provided the work or area is crafted or appointed with the intent of inspiring that emotion.

The character must decide ahead of time which single emotion she wishes to inspire, spend a blood point (mixed into the work or secreted in the area), and win a Static Social Challenge against a difficulty of seven Traits. Anyone who later views the work or enters the area feels the invested emotion. The player must note the adjudicating Storyteller, the emotion invested, and the object affected.
system.duration: Permanent, until the work or area is destroyed
